text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: URGENT: Latency SLO breach detected in us-west-2 streaming cluster. p95 jumped to ~420ms (target 150ms), p99 ~1.8s. Streaming stalls increased x4 over baseline. KV cache eviction rate spiked +32% in the last 5m. Possible slab fragmentation + prefill vs decode imbalance. Paging on-call.

oncall-alex: Ack. I'm coming in. Any immediate customer-facing impact? Which pools are hotspots?

mohammed: Quick snapshot: eviction-rate: 0.32 -> 0.42 evictions/sec per shard. prefill queue depth: 120 -> 740, decode queue depth: 90 -> 210. Hot shards: pool-usw2-1 (gpu-a100-8) and pool-usw2-3. Logs show many 'kv:prefill:oom' events. I'll grab metrics.

jess: Noted. Could be prefill producing large temporary cache entries that get evicted before decode reuses KV cache. That creates a thrash between prefill and streaming decode. Suggest temporarily disabling prefill for streaming route to test.

liam: +1. Also consider enabling slab-increase for the hot pool or bumping kv-eviction-threshold from 0.65 -> 0.75. But that takes a few minutes to roll. Prefill toggle is fastest.

mohammed: Running checks now.

# check eviction / prefill metrics
kubectl exec -it prometheus-0 -- curl -s "http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=avg(evictions_total%5B5m%5D) by (shard)"
kubectl exec -it prometheus-0 -- curl -s "http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=queue_depth_prefill%5B5m%5D"

mohammed: Results: pool-usw2-1 eviction rate 0.44, pool-usw2-3 0.39. Prefill spikes map 1:1 with eviction spikes.

oncall-alex: Can we flip prefill off for the streaming route config? If that reduces pressure we can re-enable with guardrails.

jess: I can patch the route. Command:
```
redwood-cli routes update streaming-usw2 --set prefill_enabled=false --env prod
```
I'll push the change and watch.

sre-bot: Rolling config change initiated for streaming-usw2 by jess. 0/3 hosts updated.

jess: Patch applied to 2/3 hosts. One host failed to update due to disk pressure; skipping for now.

mohammed: Early signs: p95 dropped to ~210ms in the first 90s on updated hosts. Overall cluster p95 down to ~260ms, p99 ~1.1s. Eviction rate trending down on updated hosts.

liam: Good. For the host that failed update, can we scale extra capacity or move a shard? Prefer not to restart if disk pressure is high.

ops-mira: I can spin up a temporary extra instance in pool-usw2-1 (scale +1) and start draining the overloaded host. Doing now.

sre-bot: New instance provisioned for pool-usw2-1 (i-0a1b2c3d). Rebalancing shards.

mohammed: After rebalancing: global p95 ~180ms, p99 ~900ms. Streaming stalls reduced but tail still noisy. I see a handful of sessions in tail >2s tied to a tenant doing long multi-turn streaming with large prefixes.

jess: For affected tenants with heavy prefix reuse, we should enable per-tenant rate cap temporarily and route overflow to fallback-small model to avoid double-decoding pressure.

liam: Can we enable 'fallback:small' for matches where prefix_token_count > 1024 and requests/sec > 2? We have a preflight rule.

oncall-alex: Go ahead. Also open a support ticket to notify top impacted customers: cust-alpha and cust-gamma. Need to mention temporary throughput degradation and mitigation steps.

jess: Rule deployed. Preview:
```
if request.tenant in ("cust-alpha","cust-gamma") and request.prefix_tokens > 1024:
  route -> model-fallback-small
  throttle 2rps
```

mohammed: After throttle+fallback: p99 improved to ~620ms for most sessions. Evictions normalized. Streaming stalls down to near-baseline. Good mitigation.

oncall-alex: Customer impact: cust-alpha reported 2.4% increase in timeouts from 09:12-09:28 UTC, cust-gamma 1.1% in same window. No major data loss. Add to incident notes.

liam: Root cause hypothesis for postmortem: prefill workload suddenly spiked (large-batch prefill requests) causing slab fragmentation and eviction thrash; decode pipeline couldn't reuse prefills due to scheduling imbalance -> tail stalls. Next steps: guardrail prefill rate, improve atomicity between prefill and decode jobs, and add an auto-slab-expand heuristic.

jess: Agreed. I'll create a ticket for: 1) prefill rate limiter, 2) automatic slab resize on sustained eviction > X, 3) better backpressure between prefill and decode.

sre-bot: Created issue RW-INC-8245: "prefill vs decode imbalance -> eviction thrash" assigned to eng-runtime, severity P2.

ops-mira: I'm leaving the temporary extra instance up for 2 hours. I'll continue monitoring and will drain if stable.

oncall-alex: I'm handing off to oncall-jess for the next shift. Summary: prefill toggle + tenant throttles + extra host reduced p95/p99 substantially. Customers notified. Keep watch for recurring prefill spikes and slab fragmentation. Details in RW-INC-8245 and support ticket ST-0921. :thumbsup:

oncall-jess: Taking handoff. I'll keep the page channel open and will escalate to eng-runtime if we see reoccurrence. Thanks team. :coffee:
